newsitem.title: USA: Essential Resources enters deal with China.
newsitem.headline: Essential Resources enters deal with China.

text.p: Essential Resources Inc said Monday that its wholly owned subsidiary, Collage International Health Pty Ltd, entered into a contract with a wholly owned subsidiary of China National Export Bases Development Corp.
In a release Monday, Essential Resources said the contract allows it to supply Omega-3 oil and other fish oil products under the company's label, Mother Nature.
Essential Resources said the contract provides for an initial order, valued at about $1.5 million, to be shipped in December 1996.
Chinabase is a state-owned organization of the Peoples Republic of China under the direct administration of the Ministry of Foreign Trade and Economic Cooperation, it added.
